tools.name: godatafeed_count_feeds
tools.description: Count the product feeds in the store. Use this first to check the store has feeds. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/feeds/count.

tools.name: godatafeed_list_feeds
tools.description: List the product feeds with their names and status, one page at a time. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/feeds.

tools.name: godatafeed_get_feed
tools.description: Get one feed by its id (FeedId). GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/feeds/{feedId}.

tools.name: godatafeed_count_orders
tools.description: Count the orders in a purchase date range, optionally by status. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/Orders/Count.

tools.name: godatafeed_list_orders
tools.description: List orders in a purchase date range, optionally by status, one page at a time. Use status New to find orders not yet acknowledged. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/Orders.

tools.name: godatafeed_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its GoDataFeed OrderId (from godatafeed_list_orders), with its items and status. The marketplace order number is not accepted here. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/Orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: godatafeed_get_order_fulfillments
tools.description: List the fulfillments (shipments) recorded for one order. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/Orders/{orderId}/GetFulfillments.

tools.name: godatafeed_get_order_fulfillment
tools.description: Get one fulfillment (shipment) of one order. GoDataFeed API: GET /v1/{token}/Orders/{orderId}/GetFulfillments/{fulfillmentId}.

tools.name: godatafeed_acknowledge_order
tools.description: Acknowledge one order after it is in your own system: sets its status to processing and sends your order number to the marketplace. One order per call. GoDataFeed API: PUT /v1/{token}/Orders/{id}/AcknowledgeOrder.

tools.name: godatafeed_update_order_status
tools.description: Set the destination status of one order, for example Shipped (with tracking) or Canceled. This changes the order at the marketplace. Use the date and time the order was shipped. GoDataFeed API: PUT /v1/{token}/Orders/{orderId}/UpdateStatus.

tools.name: godatafeed_insert_fulfillment
tools.description: Record a shipment (fulfillment) with a tracking number for one order. The fulfillment goes to the marketplace. Add the item SKU to attach it to one line item. GoDataFeed API: POST /v1/{token}/Orders/InsertFulfillment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: godatafeed_count_feeds, godatafeed_list_feeds, godatafeed_get_feed · Private data: godatafeed_count_feeds, godatafeed_list_feeds, godatafeed_get_feed, godatafeed_count_orders, godatafeed_list_orders, godatafeed_get_order, godatafeed_get_order_fulfillments, godatafeed_get_order_fulfillment, godatafeed_acknowledge_order, godatafeed_update_order_status, godatafeed_insert_fulfillment · Public sink: godatafeed_insert_fulfillment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: godatafeed_count_feeds, godatafeed_list_feeds, godatafeed_get_feed · Private data: godatafeed_count_feeds, godatafeed_list_feeds, godatafeed_get_feed, godatafeed_count_orders, godatafeed_list_orders, godatafeed_get_order, godatafeed_get_order_fulfillments, godatafeed_get_order_fulfillment, godatafeed_acknowledge_order, godatafeed_update_order_status, godatafeed_insert_fulfillment · Public sink: godatafeed_insert_fulfillment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
